title: Auxiliary component identity for K-injective shift comparison
statement: For every ringed-space morphism and K-injective complex, the derived direct-image comparison after the inverse derived shift map equals the shifted comparison followed by the inverse localized shift identification.

proof.text: Use the shift structure transported by rightDerivedFunctorIsoKInjectives in the unbounded right-derived triangulated construction. Express the unit restricted to K-injectives as the equivalence unit followed by this inverse comparison, with unitors and associators. Naturality of rightDerivedFunctorUnit and the equivalence triangle identity identify the expression with the restricted unit; every factor commutes with shifts.

Extend the restricted compatibility to all homotopy-category objects by NatTrans.CommShift.of_whiskerLeft. Represent an object by a complex and map it to a K-injective resolution. Its quasi-isomorphism is inverted by Qh and therefore by Qh followed by the right-derived functor. Whisker the resulting unit compatibility with the homotopy quotient and insert the quotientCompQhIso and mapHomotopyCategoryFactors identifications, including associators.

The component of this concrete complex-level natural transformation at a K-injective is the inverse of derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso from the termwise-split triangle module. Its shift equation has the localized termwise shift isomorphism on the left. Cancel the image of the localized shift map and the inverse K-injective comparison at K[1], then use the two inverse identities to obtain the exact stated equality.

theorem derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso_shift_aux
    {X Y : RingedSpace.{u}}
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y))]
    (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) ℤ) [K.IsKInjective] :
    (derivedModuleDirectImage g).map
        ((DerivedCategory.Q.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).inv.app K) ≫
      (derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso g (K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)).hom =
    ((derivedModuleDirectImage g).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ≫
      (derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso g K).hom⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫
      (moduleDirectImageLocalizedShiftIso g K).inv
